blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: А вот это кольцо с ___ (солитёр) дорогое…
exercises.why: «Prepositions "ПОД" and "ЗА" are followed by the Instrumental case when they indicate location … Prepositions "НАД", "ПЕРЕД", "МЕЖДУ" and "С".» — DLI, Lesson 61. From Александр Куприн, «Куст сирени».
exercises.context: «Prepositions "ПОД" and "ЗА" are followed by the Instrumental case when they indicate location … Prepositions "НАД", "ПЕРЕД", "МЕЖДУ" and "С".» — DLI, Lesson 61.

exercises.q: Он сегодня ___ (представлять) профессору последнюю и самую трудную практическую работу — инструментальную съёмку местности…
exercises.why: «The past tense is formed by dropping -ть from the infinitive and adding -л for the masculine, -ла for the feminine, -ло for the neuter, -ли for the plural … the past does not have special endings for each person, but shows the gender and the number.» — DLI, Lesson 36. From Александр Куприн, «Куст сирени».
exercises.context: «The past tense is formed by dropping -ть from the infinitive and adding -л for the masculine, -ла for the feminine, -ло for the neuter, -ли for the plural … the past does not have special endings for each person, but shows the gender and the number.» — DLI,…

exercises.q: Неужели ты думаешь, я ___ (поехать) оправдываться и извиняться.
exercises.why: «The perfective future consists of one word only and resembles in form the present tense. It is formed from the perfective infinitive: напишу, сделаю, получу, выучу.» — DLI, Lesson 37. From Александр Куприн, «Куст сирени».
exercises.context: «The perfective future consists of one word only and resembles in form the present tense. It is formed from the perfective infinitive: напишу, сделаю, получу, выучу.» — DLI, Lesson 37.

exercises.q: ___ (приносить) нынче профессору.
exercises.why: The letter с in the infinitive form писать is replaced by the letter ш in all forms of the present tense. The letter в is inserted in all present tense forms of the verb жить. — From the DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lessons 16–18.  ·  «The following verbs belong to the "Е" type of conjugation: думать, слушать, спрашивать … The verb лежать belongs to the "И" type of conjugation.» — DLI, Lesson 16. From Александр Куприн, «Куст сирени».
exercises.context: The letter с in the infinitive form писать is replaced by the letter ш in all forms of the present tense.

exercises.q: Ну, может быть, ___ (засмеять / засмеяться) бы только…
exercises.why: «We already know that the verbs in "-ся" may be divided into several groups … Reflexive verbs. These verbs express an action which is directed back upon the agent or subject … Reciprocal verbs. The suffix "-ся" with these verbs indicates action of two or more actors upon one another … Verbs which never occur without the ending "-ся".» — DLI, Lesson 67. From Александр Куприн, «Куст сирени».
exercises.context: «We already know that the verbs in "-ся" may be divided into several groups … Reflexive verbs. These verbs express an action which is directed back upon the agent or subject … Reciprocal verbs.…

exercises.q: Муж и жена долго ___ (стоять / лежать / сидеть / висеть) в тяжёлом раздумье, не произнося ни слова.
exercises.why: The imperfective aspect emphasizes the action itself. — From the DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 37.  ·  «Phrases meaning direction are used to denote the place where something is put ("на" + Acc., "в" + Acc., etc.)» «Literally садиться means "to seat oneself". It implies movement to a "seat" and, therefore, answers the question "куда?"» — DLI, Lessons 42, 68. From Александр Куприн, «Куст сирени».
exercises.context: The imperfective aspect emphasizes the action itself.

exercises.q: Но Верочка не ___ (давать / дать) ему падать духом и постоянно поддерживала в нём бодрость…
exercises.why: The imperfective aspect emphasizes the action itself. — From the DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 37.  ·  From Александр Куприн, «Куст сирени».
exercises.context: The imperfective aspect emphasizes the action itself.

exercises.q: Ну, засиделся я вчера, устал, руки начали ___ (дрожать / дрогнуть) — и посадил пятно…
exercises.why: The imperfective aspect emphasizes the action itself. — From the DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 37.  ·  From Александр Куприн, «Куст сирени».
exercises.context: The imperfective aspect emphasizes the action itself.

exercises.q: Ну, делать нечего, — согласился садовник, когда Вера кончила рассказывать, — ___ (сказать / говорить), какие вам можно будет посадить кусты?
exercises.why: «The imperative may be formed from both the imperfective and the perfective verbs.» — DLI, Lesson 42. From Александр Куприн, «Куст сирени».
exercises.context: «The imperative may be formed from both the imperfective and the perfective verbs.» — DLI, Lesson 42.

exercises.q: Ну и окажется в конце концов, что я лгу и в ___ (препирательство) вступаю…
exercises.why: «Prepositions "В", "НА", "ПОД" and "ЗА" are followed by the Accusative case when they indicate the goal of motion.» — DLI, Lesson 61. From Александр Куприн, «Куст сирени».
exercises.context: «Prepositions "В", "НА", "ПОД" and "ЗА" are followed by the Accusative case when they indicate the goal of motion.» — DLI, Lesson 61.

exercises.q: Оценщик с ___ (вид) усталого равнодушия закрыл глаза.

exercises.q: Слово за слово, у нас с ним ___ (завязать / завязаться) крупный разговор.
exercises.why: «We already know that the verbs in "-ся" may be divided into several groups … Reflexive verbs. These verbs express an action which is directed back upon the agent or subject … Reciprocal verbs. The suffix "-ся" with these verbs indicates action of two or more actors upon one another … Verbs which never occur without the ending "-ся".» — DLI, Lesson 67. From Александр Куприн, «Куст сирени».

exercises.q: А просто, если там нет таких дурацких кустов, то их надо ___ (поставить / положить / посадить / повесить) сейчас же.
exercises.why: The perfective aspect places the emphasis on the result of the action. — From the DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 37.  ·  «Phrases meaning direction are used to denote the place where something is put ("на" + Acc., "в" + Acc., etc.)» «Literally садиться means "to seat oneself". It implies movement to a "seat" and, therefore, answers the question "куда?"» — DLI, Lessons 42, 68. From Александр Куприн, «Куст сирени».
exercises.context: The perfective aspect places the emphasis on the result of the action.

exercises.q: Но Верочка не давала ему падать духом и постоянно ___ (поддерживать / поддержать) в нём бодрость…
exercises.why: The imperfective aspect emphasizes the action itself. — From the DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 37.  ·  From Александр Куприн, «Куст сирени».
exercises.context: The imperfective aspect emphasizes the action itself.

exercises.q: Очень удачно вышло, и ___ (разобрать / разбирать) нельзя, что пятно было.
exercises.why: The perfective aspect places the emphasis on the result of the action. — From the DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 37.  ·  From Александр Куприн, «Куст сирени».
exercises.context: The perfective aspect places the emphasis on the result of the action.

exercises.q: Нет, ты ___ (говорить / сказать) первый, а я потом.

exercises.context: «The imperative may be formed from both the imperfective and the perfective verbs.» — DLI, Lesson 42.
